title: Edmonton River Valley 60-Minute Segway Adventure
blurb:
On this 60-minute Segway tour in Edmonton, Alberta, you will receive in-depth training from a certified Segway trainer. After the training, get ready for the experience of a lifetime as you ride through Edmonton’s world famous river valley. This tour offers multiple departure times throughout the day.

Please Note: A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
